blurb: Guests do a tandem skydive including about 30 minutes of ground school training on basics like exiting the aircraft, body position during free fall, and landing procedure. The jump is from 10,500 feet with about 30 seconds of free fall and a 5-minute parachute ride. Demonstration jumps can be customized for events with options like flag flying, pyrotechnics, and costumes.
extraNote: $50 cancellation fee applied to no shows · Payment in full due the day of the skydive · In case of bad weather, reschedule for next available date · Smoketown Airport-S37311 Airport Drive Smoketown, PA 17576
